Task Name: DEC-001 Confirm LearnWorlds signed-token plan
Description content: As the project team we need the backend to receive a signed proof of the logged-in student so that a browser-supplied session ID cannot expose another student's conversation. Done when the frontend and backend agree on token issuer claims delivery header and test approach. Dependency: manager and frontend students. Demo: show an authenticated test request and a rejected unsigned request.
